messages:
maria: FYI noticed mismatch between console prefetch credits and econ attribution for yesterday's spike (~18% delta). Anyone else tracking?
aj: Where is the delta observed? route-level or tenant-level?
maria: Route-level. /chat/stream shows ~40k prefetch credits in console, econ attrib shows ~33k.
lee: Could be a telemetry keying issue. Econ join keys on hashed(route_tag)+tenant but exporter recently stopped including route_tag for warmup flows.
sofia: We flipped off the routing header for warmup last week to reduce header bloat. If exporter drops the tag, batcher still reports credits aggregated by route_tag, but econ can't join = under-attribution.
aj: Do we have an example request trace?
lee: Snippet from exporter logs: 
```
proxy: req=rcp-77 route=/chat/stream prefetch=true
exporter: wrote event req=rcp-77 tenant=team-x route_tag=
```
route_tag is blank in exporter payload for these flows.
sofia: That matches my change. I can re-enable route_tag for prefetch flows easily, but we should hash it before exporting so we don't leak internal route identifiers.
maria: Good call. Also we should add a fallback join on (req, tenant) in econ so events without route_tag still get attributed (with a lower confidence).
aj: Agree. Fallback join should set attribution_confidence=low and we should emit econ.join.fallback metric. Also add an alert if console_prefetch - econ_prefetch > 5% for 3 consecutive windows.
lee: Caution: req IDs can collide across services; include service_id and tenant scope in fallback to reduce false matches.
sofia: I'll open PR to proxy to: (a) set X-Routing-Meta for prefetch flows, (b) hash(route_tag) before export, (c) add test for warmup path. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/+/2389
deploy-bot: Deploy started: proxy sha=b7c3 -> canary-1 (10%)
aj: I'll author econ RFC to add fallback join + attribution_confidence + econ.join.fallback metric. Target deploy tonight.
maria: Can ops-analytics add the delta panel? Want a small sparkline per-route showing "console_prefetch_count - econ_attributed_prefetch_count" with sampling_rate noted. Trigger: alert after 3 windows of >5% diff.
aj: Ops-analytics owns the dashboard but eng-platform will produce the metric. I'll coordinate.
sofia: Note: mask/hmac route_tag before export so hashes match in both batcher and econ joins. We'll publish hashing scheme in the telemetry README.
lee: Timeline: sofia's proxy change -> canary in 30m, econ change -> ETL deploy later today, dashboard -> once metric lands.
maria: Action list: sofia (proxy PR + hash), lee (ETL join fallback + metric), aj (dashboard alert runbook + panel). Re-check delta after both merges. :thumbsup:
